paragraphs: CampusMind sells AI agents that colleges and universities use to automate campus operations. The agents are customizable and no-code, meant to let campus teams achieve more with less effort.

The product is organized into workforces, one of them focused on teaching and learning. Another set of agents makes PDFs accessible in bulk. Recruitment agents handle proactive student outreach. IT support agents integrate with ServiceNow and Dynamics. Agents are created and tailored through an interface the company says requires no complex coding. An institution can keep an agent private or deploy it in a chat widget, Copilot, Teams, or the agent marketplace.

The company says institutional data stays under total control, with no open models and no third-party sharing. It describes the platform as built on Microsoft Azure and designed to meet US higher education standards. An emergency response feature alerts institutional authorities. The newsletter signup names Royal Cyber Inc. alongside CampusMind.ai. The site lists an address in Naperville, Illinois, and invites buyers to begin with a two-week proof of value.

quote.text: Institutional data, total control. No open models or third-party sharing.
